profile.headline: Software Development Engineer @ Charles Schwab | Full-Stack Development, C#
profile.summary: As a Software Development Engineer at Charles Schwab, I leverage my skills in C# and full-stack development to create innovative solutions for the financial industry. With over 7 years of experience in software development, I have a strong background in management information systems and general business. I am passionate about delivering high-quality products that meet the needs of our clients and stakeholders. I am always eager to learn new technologies and best practices to enhance my skills and contribute to the success of the team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Gathered and analyzed business requirements for treasury and regulatory applications, translating business needs into technical specifications, user stories, and implementation plans. Collaborated with engineering and business teams on solution design, estimation, testing, release execution, process improvements, and stakeholder communications.

positions.title: Software Engineering Specialist
positions.description: Design, develop, and enhance enterprise-scale financial platforms supporting liquidity analytics, regulatory reporting, and treasury operations. Lead implementation of scalable software solutions using C#, .NET, SQL, APIs, and distributed architectures to support high-volume financial data processing. Drive modernization initiatives, systems integration efforts, and application resiliency improvements across critical treasury platforms. Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams to transform complex regulatory and business requirements into production-ready solutions. Contribute to architecture reviews, code reviews, release planning, production support, troubleshooting, and incident remediation. Facilitate retrospectives and continuous improvement discussions while coordinating delivery activities across development teams.
